Comment: F1 Race Intelligence pipeline orchestration (${Environment}). Input: the OpenF1 availability checker result. M2-M6 are placeholders (Pass states) until the batch jobs are deployed; with PipelineEnabled=false they are never reached.

LoadContext.Comment: Keep the availability verdict and the deployment switches side by side.

IsAvailabilityResultValid.Comment: An execution started by hand or by a malformed event must not be mistaken for 'unavailable'.

InvalidAvailabilityResult.Cause: The execution input does not contain a boolean 'available' field produced by the OpenF1 availability checker.

OpenF1Unavailable.Comment: Expected outcome (live-session restriction, rate limit, OpenF1 error): end cleanly, run nothing, try again at the next scheduled check.

PipelineDisabled.Comment: OpenF1 is available but the data-processing jobs are not enabled in this deployment (PipelineEnabled=false).

PlanSessions.Comment: PLACEHOLDER. Future: ECS RunTask (.sync) of the batch image with '--stage plan --plan-output', reading the session work units from S3. Until then it yields no sessions, so nothing downstream does any work.

PerSessionPipeline.Comment: One iteration per session: M2 -> M3 -> M4 -> M5. MaxConcurrency stays low because every M2 shares OpenF1's per-client rate limit.

M2_Extraction.Comment: PLACEHOLDER. Future: ECS RunTask (.sync) '--stage m2 --year <y> --meeting-key <m> --session-key <s>'. Retry on task failure (exit code 1 is retryable).

M3_Validation.Comment: PLACEHOLDER. Future: ECS RunTask (.sync) '--stage m3' for the same session.

M4_Consolidation.Comment: PLACEHOLDER. Future: ECS RunTask (.sync) '--stage m4' for the same session.

M5_Features.Comment: PLACEHOLDER. Future: ECS RunTask (.sync) '--stage m5' for the same session.

M6_ModelingDataset.Comment: PLACEHOLDER. Future: ECS RunTask (.sync) '--stage m6' once every session has been processed (global batch: the temporal split needs the whole history).

NotifyPipelineFailure.Comment: Critical: a pipeline stage failed after its retries.

PipelineFailed.Cause: A pipeline stage failed; details were published to the alert topic.
